title: StackDiff: path-consistency DNS differential harness (v0.1.2)
description: Checksummed smoke, adversarial, malformed-capture, and robustness manifests for Unbound/dnsmasq pair-mode path-consistency measurements (results tag results-dns02-20260815; Package B capture-malformed-20260816T032622Z; Package C robustness-20260816T034020Z).
